|translation='''Title''' — [[Rebel Guard]].

'''Lore''' — Gailan Torg was chosen for honorary guard duty during the ceremony celebrating victory at the Battle of Yavin. Faithful to the assignment, he is typical of the unsung heroes of the Rebel Alliance.

'''Game text''' — Cannot move. Treat power as 0 while attacking and as 4 while defending.
|translation_note=Name prints ゲイラン・トーグ, not Galen. Lore says faithful and unsung, not hard-working. 攻撃中 / 防御中 vs an offensive battle / defending a battle.
